import re,collections
s=open('/challenge/CtfTask.v').read()
i=s.index('module CtfTask'); j=s.index('endmodule',i); mod=s[i:j]
# find primitive module defs for FDCE etc
# parse instances: \name  inst ( .pin(sig), ...);
insts=re.findall(r'\\?\$paramod\\[^\s]+\s+(_\d+)\s*\((.*?)\);', mod, re.S)
print("num instances",len(insts))
regs=collections.defaultdict(dict)  # basename -> {bit: (D)} plus clock
# identify FF cells by module name containing FDCE/FDPE
for m in re.finditer(r'(\$paramod\\[^\s]+)\s+(_\d+)\s*\((.*?)\);', mod, re.S):
    modname=m.group(1); inst=m.group(2); body=m.group(3)
    if 'FDCE' in modname or 'FDPE' in modname:
        pins=dict(re.findall(r'\.(\w+)\(([^)]*)\)', body))
        Q=pins.get('Q','').strip(); D=pins.get('D','').strip()
        mm=re.match(r'\\?([^\[\]]+?)\[(\d+)\]', Q)
        if mm:
            regs[mm.group(1)][int(mm.group(2))]=D
        else:
            regs[Q][0]=D
for name in sorted(regs, key=lambda x:-len(regs[x])):
    bits=regs[name]
    print(name, "bits=",len(bits), "D:", [bits.get(k) for k in range(len(bits))][:12])
